references.title: Portable Network Graphics (PNG) Specification (Third Edition)
references.retrieval: Actual HTML successfully fetched and inspected using urllib; no local source copy retained.
references.observed: CRC covers chunk type and data, excluding chunk length; initial all-one CRC, final inversion, least-significant data-bit first. PNG8 gray color type0 and RGB color type2, filter0 and noninterlace use the standard zlib stream.

references.retrieval: Actual source downloaded and _tr_stored_block function inspected; no C code copied into RTL or retained.
references.observed: _tr_stored_block emits (STORED_BLOCK<<1)+last as 3 bits, byte-aligns using bi_windup, writes little-endian length and ones-complement length, then copies raw bytes.
references.differences: Original RTL implements this standard stored-block representation with fixed65535-byte boundaries, no LZ77 search/Huffman coding. zlib/Pillow may choose different boundaries, filters or compression methods while decoding to identical pixels; file bytes are not expected to equal Pillow.save output.

actual_mature_validation: Every functional case streams actual RTL output bytes into Pillow.Image.open/load and Python zlib.decompressobj; CRC32 and Adler32 are independently recomputed with zlib. Versions are recorded in evidence.json.
numerical_oracle: Independent declarative byte construction with struct packing, input scanlines and zlib checksum functions; no encoder state-machine model.
